# Recreation Prompt

Recreate `Prism League Trail` as a mobile-first portrait browser game. Preserve the source mechanics: a bottom-screen avatar follows pointer/touch horizontal input while elemental companion encounters scroll downward through three lanes; colliding with an encounter collects it, updates a persistent 500-slot dex, restores team bond, and produces feedback; bond drains over time and reaching zero triggers a rival-caught-up game-over with restart. Present the game as a bright Pokemon-inspired creature-collector coming-of-age route adventure with a rookie trainer, elemental monsters, team building, rarity tiers, a prism dex, rival energy, and authored procedural route scenery. Use a single self-contained `index.html` with inline CSS/JS, Canvas rendering, mobile-readable HUD, tappable pause/dex/restart controls, catalog-approved audio/GIF accents, and no assets from `assets/` except allowed CSS/JS references.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The preserved source is a portrait-first canvas collection runner. A rookie/tamer avatar stays near the bottom of the screen, follows pointer/touch horizontal input, and collides with downward-moving entities spawned in three lanes. Contact collects the entity, updates a persistent 500-entry collection, restores energy/bond, emits feedback, and removes the entity. Bond/energy drains over time and game over occurs at zero. Menu, collection index, pause/resume, restart, and game-over overlays are part of the state flow.

## Protected mechanics
- Canvas loop with `requestAnimationFrame` update/render cadence.
- Pointer/touch horizontal movement to set avatar target X.
- Three-lane spawn distribution and downward scrolling encounter flow.
- Collision-to-collect semantics, including new-versus-repeat bond rewards.
- Persistent 500-entry collection index and rarity tiers.
- Bond/fuel decay, warning threshold, game-over at zero, restart flow.

## Remix target
`Prism League Trail` reframes the protected collection runner as a bright Pokemon-inspired creature-collector route rush: a rookie trainer builds an elemental companion team while a rival pressures the journey. The mechanics remain collection-runner truth, while the HUD, scene, companion silhouettes, dex language, rival failure fantasy, and procedural route art carry the creature-collector RPG identity.
